purpose: Post-hoc diagnostic audit, not a new frozen superiority benchmark
phase_reference_information: Period 60 is DGP-informed and already in original candidate grid; not automatically discovered
oracle_target_information: True conditional means/variances are privileged diagnostics and never supplied to the original fits
selection_rule: Choose diagnostic hyperparameters/candidates using training/validation only; do not select by original held-out outcomes
limits: One realization; conditional expected risks and Monte Carlo replications do not constitute independent DGP replications
